  "text": "The leave-one-project-out preference benchmark separately requires at least 24 independently verified holdout decisions, 4 distinct projects containing verified truth, fallback precision of at least 0.95, coverage of at least 0.25, and zero wrong fallback decisions. Project breadth counts only projects with independently confirmed/corrected truth; projects containing only shadow or rejected observations cannot satisfy it. Meeting the benchmark permits advisory host preference only; authority, routing, canonical rewrite and auto-apply remain false. A reviewed versioned feature flag, exploration floor and immediate rollback are still required for activation.
